source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundEmailDTOEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResultField authField = new Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResultField(); authField.name = 'smtp.mailfrom'; authField.value = 'example.com'; Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResult auth = new Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResult(); auth.method = 'spf'; auth.result = 'pass'; auth.authenticationResultFields = new List<Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResultField>{authField}; Messaging.InboundEmail email = new Messaging.InboundEmail(); email.authenticationResults = new List<Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResult>{auth}; System.assertEquals('spf', email.authenticationResults[0].method); System.assertEquals('spf', auth.method); System.assertEquals('pass', auth.result); System.assertEquals('smtp.mailfrom', auth.authenticationResultFields[0].name); Messaging.InboundEmail.Header header = new Messaging.InboundEmail.Header(); header.name = 'Content-Type'; header.value = 'text/plain'; Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment binary = new Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment(); binary.body = Blob.valueOf('trail'); binary.fileName = 'trail.bin'; binary.headers = new List<Messaging.InboundEmail.Header>{header}; binary.mimeTypeSubType = 'application/octet-stream'; System.assertEquals('trail.bin', binary.fileName); System.assertEquals(1, binary.headers.size()); Messaging.InboundEmail.TextAttachment text = new Messaging.InboundEmail.TextAttachment(); text.body = 'trail text'; text.bodyIsTruncated = false; text.charset = 'UTF-8'; text.fileName = 'trail.txt'; text.headers = new List<Messaging.InboundEmail.Header>{header}; text.mimeTypeSubType = 'text/plain'; System.assertEquals('trail text', text.body); System.assertEquals(false, text.bodyIsTruncated); System.assertEquals('UTF-8', text.charset); System.assertEquals('trail.txt', text.fileName); System.assertEquals('text/plain', text.mimeTypeSubType); } }
